target_boundary: Explain the tracking design inside projects/autoads: how creative variants are tracked through network dispatch, outcome capture, KPI normalization, veracidade grading, promotion gates, owner decision, and feedback into the next creative cycle.

reader_contract.target_public: A product or engineering reader who understands ad iteration but has not yet internalized the autoads tracking architecture.
assumed_knowledge: The reader knows that ad creatives are tested on ad networks.
The reader can read a simple pipeline diagram and a gate table.
reader_contract.reader_reward: The reader can explain why autoads treats ad-network metrics as evidence, not authority, and where tracking data is allowed to influence future creative generation.

must_start_with: Start from the tracking problem: an ad metric is only useful if the system knows what was tested, when it was observed, and what can safely be concluded.
Introduce autoads as a governed Creative Learning Cycle before naming local node types.
must_not_start_with: Do not start with a generic advertising dashboard explanation.
Do not imply live ad-network integration has already been executed.
opening_contract.failure_message: If the page makes raw CTR look like a direct source of truth, it fails the tracking design contract.

reader_terms.plain_meaning: One closed loop that generates a variant, tracks outcomes, grades the evidence, decides promote or retire, and feeds the next cycle.
reader_terms.why_it_matters: It is the smallest unit of value in autoads and the shape every tracking decision must support.
reader_terms.misuse_warning: Do not treat it as an executed production pipeline; the seed says it is not yet executed.

reader_terms.plain_meaning: A network-neutral boundary that dispatches a variant and pulls outcomes without locking autoads to one ad platform.
reader_terms.why_it_matters: It keeps tracking portable while making the real network schema a validation gap before any live pilot.
reader_terms.misuse_warning: Do not assume Meta, Google, TikTok, or any other network has already been integrated.

reader_terms.plain_meaning: A sourced event saying the network received a variant or returned outcome data.
reader_terms.why_it_matters: Every tracked fact starts with provenance: source, API version or endpoint, locator, and capture time.
reader_terms.misuse_warning: An event without source information is rejected at ingest.

reader_terms.plain_meaning: A normalized metric family such as engagement rate, cost efficiency, attribution depth, or creative lift.
reader_terms.why_it_matters: The family defines numerator, denominator, response window, interpretation limit, and evidence references.
reader_terms.misuse_warning: Do not compare metrics whose denominator or observation window is different.

reader_terms.plain_meaning: A confidence grade for how much external evidence supports a metric, candidate, or projection.
reader_terms.why_it_matters: It prevents a high-performing metric from automatically becoming a high-confidence recommendation.
reader_terms.misuse_warning: A high CTR is not the same thing as high veracidade.

reader_terms.plain_meaning: The concrete source, event, test, or campaign references that justify a grade.
reader_terms.why_it_matters: They make the tracking record auditable and stop claims from floating away from the evidence.
reader_terms.misuse_warning: Do not promote a knowledge projection without non-empty evidence references.

reader_terms.plain_meaning: The fixed time interval over which outcomes are counted for a creative family.
reader_terms.why_it_matters: It prevents post-hoc window changes and premature promotion before the observation period closes.
reader_terms.misuse_warning: Do not count late conversions or early signals outside the declared window as settled proof.

reader_terms.plain_meaning: A check for factors that could explain the metric without proving the creative pattern.
reader_terms.why_it_matters: Audience selection, attribution drift, window mismatch, day-of-week, seasonality, or network capacity can make a winner look real too early.
reader_terms.misuse_warning: Unresolved confounds block promotion unless an owner records an explicit strategic-bet override.

reader_terms.plain_meaning: A routing table that classifies ad-network fields by sensitivity and allowed use.
reader_terms.why_it_matters: It determines whether tracking data can be computed locally, stored privately, redacted, shared as aggregate, or rejected.
reader_terms.misuse_warning: Do not let PII-bearing identifiers, spend details, or unclassified network fields leak into shared projections.

reader_terms.plain_meaning: The human approval node that decides whether a graded candidate can become reusable knowledge.
reader_terms.why_it_matters: It keeps tracking evidence from approving itself and records approved allowed uses.
reader_terms.misuse_warning: No candidate or metric bypasses owner review.

layer_reader_outcomes.as_a_reader: As a product reader, I want the page to say what problem tracking solves.
layer_reader_outcomes.should_understand: autoads is not just a creative generator; it is a governed loop for tracking what happened and what can safely be reused.
layer_reader_outcomes.because_it_matters_for: avoiding dashboard-shaped thinking where raw metrics are treated as final truth.

layer_reader_outcomes.as_a_reader: As an implementation reader, I want the tracking invariants named.
layer_reader_outcomes.should_understand: Every variant has lineage and an outcome contract; every metric needs denominator semantics, response window, veracidade, and evidence_refs.
layer_reader_outcomes.because_it_matters_for: knowing which data fields must exist before a cycle can be trusted.

layer_reader_outcomes.as_a_reader: As an architecture reader, I want the pieces of the tracking loop separated.
layer_reader_outcomes.should_understand: Generator, Network Adapter, Outcome Measurement, Grader, Promotion DAG, OwnerDecision, Feedback Loop, and Auto-Research each own a different part of the tracking story.
layer_reader_outcomes.because_it_matters_for: diagnosing where a tracking claim was created, normalized, graded, blocked, or reused.

layer_reader_outcomes.as_a_reader: As a reviewer, I want to know what depends on what inside autoads.
layer_reader_outcomes.should_understand: Outcome measurement depends on variant lineage and declared windows; grading depends on KPI evidence and confounds; feedback depends on owner-governed promotion.
layer_reader_outcomes.because_it_matters_for: spotting shortcuts that would collapse the tracking chain.

layer_reader_outcomes.as_a_reader: As a reviewer, I want to know what autoads does not own.
layer_reader_outcomes.should_understand: Ad-network APIs, attribution models, privacy policy, Ontologize DAG rules, and owner decisions sit outside the seed's executed code path.
layer_reader_outcomes.because_it_matters_for: knowing why bounded research and owner review remain required.

layer_reader_outcomes.as_a_reader: As a working reader, I want to trace one tracked creative cycle.
layer_reader_outcomes.should_understand: A variant moves from generated hypothesis to network event, raw outcomes, KPI observation, grader gate, promotion candidate, owner decision, knowledge projection, and feedback.
layer_reader_outcomes.because_it_matters_for: understanding how tracking data changes form before it can improve future creatives.

layer_reader_outcomes.as_a_reader: As an operator, I want to know when tracking evidence becomes actionable.
layer_reader_outcomes.should_understand: The seed starts with fixtures, hardens governance, then requires bounded research before replacing the stub adapter with a live single-network pilot.
layer_reader_outcomes.because_it_matters_for: not mistaking the seed for a production integration.

layer_reader_outcomes.as_a_reader: As an operator, I want the open gaps visible.
layer_reader_outcomes.should_understand: Network schemas, attribution windows, confound thresholds, candidate-to-card contract, and ads generalization are still validation hypotheses.
layer_reader_outcomes.because_it_matters_for: planning the next routes before trusting live spend or cross-network reuse.

layer_reader_outcomes.as_a_reader: As a scanner, I want each visual to answer a different tracking question.
layer_reader_outcomes.should_understand: The spine shows movement, the gate board shows stop conditions, the boundary map shows ownership, and the lifecycle strip shows validation maturity.
layer_reader_outcomes.because_it_matters_for: moving from overview to diagnosis without losing evidence boundaries.

evidence: projects/autoads/README.md defines autoads as a creative-development pipeline that generates better ad creatives by measuring ad-network outcomes.
projects/autoads/README.md says ad-network outcomes become governed events and the Promotion DAG decides which creatives or patterns are trustworthy.
projects/autoads/README.md says the project is seed-authored and validated, not yet executed.
inference: The most useful explanation lens is not ad analytics in general, but tracking as evidence governance from event to reusable creative knowledge.

evidence: stages/06-design-creative-pipeline.md says a creative variant carries lineage, ontology_card_ref, hypothesis_ref, generation_method, creative fields, objective, governance_class, and an outcome_contract.
stages/06-design-ad-network-measurement.md says KPI families carry veracidade, evidence_refs, response_window, and interpretation_limit.
stages/06-design-creative-pipeline.md says response windows are fixed at family creation and minimum sample thresholds are declared before statistical tests.
stages/06-design-ad-network-measurement.md says metrics must report denominator definition and source-event chain.
inference: Tracking correctness depends more on predeclared measurement shape than on the specific ad-network metric names.

evidence: projects/autoads/DESIGN.md lists Creative Generator, Network Adapter, Outcome Measurement, Grader, Promotion DAG, Auto-Research, and Feedback Loop.
stages/05-distill.md calls the Creative Learning Cycle the smallest coherent unit: generate, dispatch, measure, grade, review, owner decision, promote or retire, residue, feedback.
stages/06-design-auto-research.md says auto-research mines internal residue, competitor creatives, and trend signals into reviewed candidates.
inference: OwnerDecision is represented as its own visual gate because the seed repeatedly emphasizes that promotion requires owner approval.

evidence: stages/06-design-creative-pipeline.md says outcomes are measured over a shared response window for a family and confounds are measured as deltas to control.
stages/06-design-ad-network-measurement.md says OutcomeEvent becomes MetricObservation only after source and denominator rules are satisfied.
stages/06-design-ad-network-measurement.md says unresolved confounds and low veracidade block advancement to PromotionCandidate.
stages/06-design-auto-research.md says outcomes feed auto-research memory through drifts_from, contradicts, and promoted_from Promotion DAG edges.
inference: The tracking chain is a dependency ladder: each downstream claim is only meaningful if the upstream event, window, denominator, and confound evidence are intact.

evidence: stages/04-research-decision.md says real ad-network outcome metrics, attribution windows, data export, and identifier sensitivity are an external gap.
stages/06-design-ad-network-measurement.md defines the Network Adapter as network-neutral across Meta, Google, TikTok, and similar systems.
stages/06-design-ad-network-measurement.md classifies spend as business-sensitive, audience_target as private, network_metrics as varies by network, and click_id/conversion_event_id as PII-bearing.
projects/ontologize/DAG-AND-METRICS.md defines the upstream DAG node and gate model reused by autoads.
inference: The seed can explain the tracking contract, but live API semantics and field sensitivity must still be verified per network.

evidence: projects/autoads/DESIGN.md diagrams Auto-Research to Creative Generator to Network Adapter to Outcome Measurement to Grader to Promotion DAG to Feedback Loop.
stages/06-design-ad-network-measurement.md gives a concrete gate flow from OutcomeEvent to MetricObservation to PromotionCandidate to OwnerDecision to KnowledgeProjection.
stages/06-design-ontology-reuse.md maps CreativeDispatch and NetworkOutcome to N1, MetricObservation to N3, PromotionCandidate to N4, OwnerDecision to N5, and KnowledgeProjection to N6.
inference: A linear tracking spine with explicit block edges best explains how data changes authority as it moves.

evidence: projects/autoads/PLAN.md says Layer 0 uses a stub network adapter with fixture outcomes, no live calls, no PII, and no credentials.
projects/autoads/PLAN.md says Layer 1 installs a field-to-authority-class register, deterministic Promotion DAG gates, and reviewed auto-research candidates.
projects/autoads/PLAN.md says Layer 2 replaces the stub with one real Network Adapter after bounded research, then tunes confound thresholds on real traffic.
projects/autoads/PLAN.md says Layer 3 closes the auto-research memory loop and generalizes the adapter to a second network.
inference: Tracking maturity moves from proof with fixtures, to governance hardening, to a validated single-network pilot, to multi-network learning.

evidence: projects/autoads/RESULT.md carries H1 network schema/windows, H2 confound thresholds, H3 auto-research-generator card contract, and H4 ads generalization as open hypotheses.
stages/07-design-review.md flags that those hypotheses must stay visible and that the thin first slice must be explicit.
stages/06-design-ad-network-measurement.md says PII escape, unclassified fields, unresolved confounds, low veracidade, and metric self-promotion block or fail closed.
stages/04-research-decision.md says external research was not run and recommends bounded research on one target network before the MVP pilot.
inference: The tracking design should be treated as ready for a stubbed proof slice, not ready for live spend or buyer-facing claims.

evidence: arcanum/arcana/x-ray/SKILL.md says L0 static HTML/SVG is the default proof path.
arcanum/arcana/x-ray/library/patterns.yml includes process-branch, dependency-boundary, lifecycle-stack, and evidence-inference-split patterns.
arcanum/arcana/x-ray/library/components.yml includes shape.node, shape.boundary, connector.arrow, connector.branch, connector.feedback-loop, chart.timeline-strip, and chart.risk-matrix.
inference: The HTML should combine a tracking spine, field authority map, gate board, dependency boundary, maturity strip, and evidence split rather than a single generic architecture diagram.
